up: Return all activity records for dapagliflozin (CHEMBL429910) and its salt forms against the target sodium/glucose cotransporter 2 (CHEMBL3884). The activity records must be of type IC50. Include the following columns: compound ChEMBL ID, compound name, canonical SMILES, activity ID, standard relation, standard value, standard units, pChEMBL value, assay ChEMBL ID, assay description, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and the PubMed ID from the associated document. Ensure that dapagliflozin and all its salt forms are included in the results.
sql:
WITH compounds AS (
  SELECT child.molregno, child.chembl_id, child.pref_name
  FROM molecule_dictionary parent
  JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno
  JOIN molecule_dictionary child ON child.molregno = mh.molregno
  WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL429910'
), target AS (
  SELECT tid, chembl_id, pref_name
  FROM target_dictionary
  WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3884'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  c.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  c.pref_name AS compound_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.activity_id,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.pchembl_value,
  ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  t.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  t.pref_name AS target_name,
  d.pubmed_id
FROM compounds c
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = c.molregno
JOIN activities a ON a.molregno = c.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id
CROSS JOIN target t
LEFT JOIN docs d ON d.doc_id = a.doc_id
WHERE ass.tid = t.tid
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50';
